in_marathi.name: Jashvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of Joy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jashvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jash (joy) + Vika (bringer) - The name Jashvika means 'Bringer of Joy'. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the embodiment of joy, wealth, and prosperity.

in_bengali.name: Jashvika
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Bringer of Joy
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jashvika একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jash (joy) + Vika (bringer) - The name Jashvika means 'Bringer of Joy'. In Hindu mythology, it is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, who is the embodiment of joy, wealth, and prosperity.
